mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production, defined as a 2% y-o-y drop in the industrial production index, signals a weakening supply-side environment that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth falls by > 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, defined as a 10% m-o-m decline, signals a rapidly weakening housing market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4%, an additional 25bp hike signals a tightening monetary environment that will pressure equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and rises by 25bp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4%, a 0.2pp increase signals a tightening labor market that will pressure corporate margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and rises by 0.2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is accelerating, a sharp drop in retail sales signals a disconnect between macro growth and consumer spending that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is accelerating y-o-y but RSAFS declines > 5% m-o-m and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is in a y-o-y decline, a further drop in housing starts signals a broadening of the supply-side slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth is negative and HOUST declines > 5% m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.
